scope: Equity Uprise shared-platform support-only database inventory; no building capabilities, runtime policy or deployment changes.

methods.filename_enumeration: GitHub list_pr_changed_filenames automatically paginates all file-list pages. Refetched for moved/new heads.
methods.pinned_sql_validation: git merge-base <pinned-base> <pinned-head>; git diff --name-status --find-renames <merge-base> <head> -- *.sql; every SQL path exactly agrees with API file inventory. git ls-tree and cat-file establish blob identity and exact bytes.
methods.database_related_path_filter: All supabase/ paths plus migration/ledger/schema/reconciliation/Supabase/SQL/database/reset/source-map/PROMOTION filenames. Complete changed filenames remain attached for every PR, including names outside this grouping filter.
methods.create_name_scan: Lexical CREATE TABLE/FUNCTION/VIEW/SEQUENCE name extraction; catalog presence by qualified name. Not a full SQL parser or a signature/body/column/privilege compatibility check.
methods.main_reference_scan: Quoted unqualified extracted names on individual lines in main runtime sources under core/, workers/, supabase/functions/, js/, excluding tests/fixtures; the call subset requires rpc/from/call-field syntax on the same line. A negative result does not prove absence of multiline, dynamic or deployed callers.
methods.exact_live_sql_comparison: MD5 of complete file bytes equals md5(array_to_string(schema_migrations.statements,E\n)); matching versions named for each file. Filename resemblance or existing object names alone do not prove application.

live_ledger.query: select version::text,name,md5(array_to_string(statements,E'\n')) as sql_md5,octet_length(array_to_string(statements,E'\n')) as sql_bytes from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations order by version;

priorities.disposition: The five forward canonical records copy live SQL exactly; record only, do not reapply.
Follow their precise SQL/proof/CI/approval plans. This inventory does not turn an open draft into permission to apply.
Three declared names absent live and no literal main runtime reference; new feature callers are unmerged. Independent SQL, rollback, auth and cache review required.
24 declared names absent live; standalone staged ledger/accounting feature. Current feature review and native proof required.

Changes two existing CHECK constraints and three existing policy RPC bodies. No seeded policy and no Halo route consumes it. Text-only SQL checks at pinned head; prepare native drift/concurrency/recovery proof before any application.
#834 adds device_facts but omits the service_role revoke fixed in #823. Never apply both files by basename; reconcile the distinct contracts and preserve #823 privilege/recovery fixes.

priorities.topic: Older unreviewed proposals outside the standard pending folder
priorities.disposition: Includes direct canonical-folder additions and legacy pending folders. Presence in an old PR is not approval or evidence of a current production requirement.

limitations: The original 51-file inventory covered main supabase/pending only; it was not an all-open-PR inventory.
This is complete filename/content inventory at the pinned 120-PR snapshot, not a full native execution or semantic security review of every historical SQL proposal.
No claim is made that historical proposals are abandoned; they remain unmerged/staged, unapproved and may be superseded only after source reconciliation.
CREATE-name existence does not prove exact function overloads, bodies, columns, constraints, indexes, grants, data or feature activation.
Literal main source references do not establish deployed code identity and do not discover dynamically assembled callers or every ALTER/seed dependency.
Later commits and PRs are outside this snapshot; active lane heads and subsequent review receipts must be rechecked before release.
No production SQL was executed by this inventory and no PR was modified.
